Services

Colour first. Cut to match.

Polly & Stone was founded in 2021 by Jasmine Redstone and Jack Pollard, British Hairdressing Award winners. The salon specialises in colour that is planned around the person in the chair — not rushed, not templated.

Complex colour

Multi-dimensional colour, planned in a dedicated appointment and built around your hair, your skin tone and how much maintenance you actually want.

Book a colour appointment →

Balayage & blondes

Soft, lived-in balayage and bright, clean blondes — the salon's signature work.

Book →

Keratin smoothing

The P&S Smoothing Treatment, priced by hair length and booked by time — from $367.

See smoothing prices →

Precision cutting

Cutting that supports the colour — shape, movement and a finish that grows out gracefully.

How booking works

Three steps to your chair.

1

Choose your salon & service

Pick Turramurra or Erina Heights, then the service — smoothing, colour, balayage, cutting or an up-style.

2

Send your request

Fill in the form below. It opens an email to the salon you chose, ready to send — nothing is booked until the salon replies.

3

The salon confirms your time

Polly & Stone confirms your appointment directly, including smoothing bookings that run 2 to 4 hours.

Why this page exists: the salon's own website had no online booking — contact was by email or text message only. This page adds the booking step the salon was missing, without changing how the salon confirms appointments.
Book now

Request your appointment.

Choose your salon — your request goes to that salon's own email. Turramurra requests go to hello@pollyandstone.com.au; Erina Heights requests go to CentralCoast@pollyandstone.com.au.

Sending opens your email app with the request addressed to the salon you chose. Your appointment is confirmed when the salon replies — this page does not book it by itself. Prefer to call? Turramurra 0435 294 866 · Erina Heights 0431 099 521.
